## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `169a40a03336f679cb791b9d3d3d799c16921bfa`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md, skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json + .changeset/33566-skills-position-rename-own-source.md

Read-only shape: the diff of the one commit `169a40a0` over its parent `63db7240` (the merge base; no merge commit on the branch, so a main merge authored nothing), card #33566 and its order, dev report 6899557790, the PR body, the head's check-runs, and the cited code on main `27c2f1ea`. Main moved two unrelated changesets since the base; the branch merges clean.

### ① Derived judgments

Each added or changed sentence, against main:

- "At boot its holders move ... Only holders" and "The boot log lists stored references by table (sharing, queue and share recipients, pending approvers, invitations) for an admin": HOLDS. `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-renamed-holder-carry.ts` module doc, "What it names and never writes" (lines 76-84): "Holders only (ruling A1). Every other stored reference to an old name stays as it is and is listed by table, so an administrator can re-point it in Setup".
- "no metadata is read or rewritten, a Setup-authored body included": DOES NOT HOLD as written. See M-1.
- "Re-point your own source naming the old one: a `type: 'position'` sharing recipient, queue member or approver, a policy's `positions`, a `current_user.positions` predicate": HOLDS. Each is a real authoring site: `packages/spec/src/security/sharing.zod.ts:141` (`'position'` recipient type), `packages/spec/src/security/queue.zod.ts:47` (`type: z.literal('position', ...)`), `packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts:33` (`'position'` approver type), `packages/spec/src/security/rls.zod.ts:625` (`positions: z.array(z.string())`), and the `'NAME' in current_user.positions` predicate form (`ui/packages/types/src/select-option.ts:80`). Card item 1 is met.
- "recorded under another owner (a package or the environment)": HOLDS. Same file, `owned-by-other` (lines 59-65): "the activation ledger records it under ANOTHER package (or, for a position the environment authored, under any package) ... a row carrying the environment's sentinel (`sys_metadata`) records the environment as the owner, so a package's claim is refused"; `OVERLAY_PROVENANCE_SENTINEL = 'sys_metadata'` (line 173); test rows 214 and 216 of `position-renamed-holder-carry.test.ts` refuse both directions. Card item 2 is met.
- "Explaining another user takes `manage_users`, administering one of their organizations, or a delegated `adminScope` covering them": HOLDS, and is the whole operator gate. `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-explain-access.ts#mayDescribeAnotherUser` (lines 145-165): `if (held.has('manage_users')) return true;` then `organizationAdminCoversUser(callerSets, userId, callerContext)` then `scopesCoverUser(callerSets, userId, callerContext)`; the denial text (line 196) names the same three. The system-caller arm is rightly left out. Routes `GET` / `POST {basePath}/security/explain` (`packages/rest/src/security-routes.ts:423,429`). Card item 4 is met, in the section an operator reads when a grant looks inert. Premise check: no other `skills/**` file on main states this rule.
- "Only a tenant admin ... may `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_permission_set`": a merge of two sentences, meaning unchanged.
- "a kernel name (a fixed placeholder above, `accessible_org_ids`)": HOLDS. `packages/spec/src/contracts/rls-membership-resolver.ts:100` `RESERVED_RLS_MEMBERSHIP_KEYS` = `id`, `organization_id`, `positions`, `org_user_ids`, `accessible_org_ids`, `email`, `queues`; the placeholder table above the bullet carries the six fixed ones and `accessible_org_ids` is kept by name.
- "`outside-closure` / `ambiguous-in-closure` as for a queue above (...)": the queue bullet of the previous section defines both; the Setup-authored-set and install-refusal clauses are kept. Holds, tersely (N-2).

The eight cuts and their homes:

| Cut | Home claimed | Reading |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `tabPermissions` pointer bullet | objectstack-ui `rules/navigation.md` § Who sees or opens an app | the rule survives there in full ("Not an access gate"), and objectstack-ui `SKILL.md:149` routes to it; it is NOT in the skill this file's reader has loaded. See S-1 |
| kernel-name list | placeholder table, same file | survives |
| membership-tier closed list | the docs anchor kept in the sentence | survives outside the bundle only (the docs URL), and in `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md:251`; `external`, the one tier this bullet teaches, is kept. Acceptable |
| second definition of the two refusal codes | queue bullet, same file | survives |
| ", or refused below" | next bullet ("grants nothing through that name") | survives |
| "Assignment is one `POST`" | merged sentence | survives |
| "Declare the set on the **roster** object ..." | section heading and the "Choose by what the rows are keyed on" bullet | survives |
| `// in a permission set` comment | RLS paragraph above ("policies on a **permission set / profile**") | survives |

Size: the head file is 15835 bytes, 3959 tokens against the unmoved ceiling 3959 (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs:1049`); one spare byte.

Eval case 21: self-consistent in the narrow sense (both `must_contain` strings occur in `expected_output`; the `must_not_contain` string does not). It does trip on a correct answer: see S-2. Its `expected_output` repeats the sentence of M-1.

Check-runs on the head, read at 19:00Z: no failure. Success: Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check PR Size, Type Check (workspace, source gates, debt ledger), four scoped Lint jobs, Live E2E UI, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate. Still in progress at the read: Build Core, Test Core shards, Lint · ESLint, Lint · docs and code guards, Lint · repo and tooling gates, Lint · CI, release and engine gates, Type Check · consumer gates. The record does not vouch for those.

### ② Semver level

Patch on the skills package is right: published skill prose and one eval fixture, no schema, no runtime, no ratchet row. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are on the changeset and the PR body and match the order. The changeset's prose carries the sentence of M-1 into the changelog and is corrected with it.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev open question (keep the `tabPermissions` cut, or restore it): answered B, restore, in a shorter form. Reasons under S-1. Not a blocker.
- Deviation, authoring through an isolated dev pinned at tier on the same branch: as the order prescribes; recorded in the PR body.
- Deviation, the ratchet row comment still reads `ceil(15834 / 4)`: accepted, the pinned ceiling is unchanged and true for 15835 bytes; the row is not touched, so the diff stays off the ratchet file.
- File surface: three paths, all inside the order's surface; `rules/relationships.md` and `evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` untouched.
- Landing tier: the dev's `--pr` reading of Tier H is not re-run here (read-only shape); nothing in the diff argues against it.
- SQL push-down: no code in the diff; nothing to check.
- Security: no security item found.

### ④ Design judgment

**M-1 (must-fix) — "no metadata is read or rewritten, a Setup-authored body included" says more than the code does, and is false for a position the environment authored.** The carry reads metadata: `position-renamed-holder-carry.ts` "What it does" (lines 23-25): "it reads every position's `renamedFrom` from the security catalog and judges each old name", over "every code, package and environment position this boot registers". A Setup-authored position body is among them and its claim is carried: `position-renamed-holder-carry.test.ts:347-361`, an environment position (`_packageId: 'sys_metadata'`, `renamedFrom: ['old_rep']`) yields `carried: [{ from: 'old_rep', to: 'env_rep', packageId: null, rows: 1 }]`. The sentence the code offers is narrower (lines 89-91): "Not a metadata rewrite: Setup-authored bodies that name an old position are not read". The skill dropped the qualifier, so a reader is told a Setup-authored position's `renamedFrom` is not read, three lines above a refusal list that names the environment as a claimant's owner. The PR body sees the case and argues the sentence "says nothing against that"; as written it does. The card's item 3 is "teach only what the code does". Fix: say what is not rewritten, not what is not read, for example "no other reference to the old name is rewritten, Setup-authored ones included" (+13 bytes against one spare byte: pay in place), and carry the same correction into eval 21's `expected_output` ("Only holders move: no metadata is read or rewritten") and the changeset prose.

**S-1 (should-fix) — restore the `tabPermissions` line (the dev's open question, option B).** PR #32616 landed it on purpose ("`objectstack-data` `rules/security.md` gains one line under permission sets"): it is the only sentence in the file that teaches permission sets which keeps an author from using a visibility key as an access gate. The spec a data-skill reader is routed to says only "App/tab visibility" (`packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts:1302-1303`), not that the app still opens. The full rule's home in objectstack-ui is right and stays; what is lost is the route to it from the page where the key is authored, and a reader of this file has not necessarily loaded that skill. A pointer is not a duplicate of the rule under the pay-in-place ruling. Pay with another cut, or with a measured row raise: the PR already reads Tier H, so a moved row changes nothing about its landing.

**S-2 (should-fix) — eval 21's `must_not_contain` string occurs in its own prompt.** `value: 'sales_rep'` is how the prompt spells the rule, so a correct answer that shows before and after ("change `{ type: 'position', value: 'sales_rep' }` to ...") fails the case. No other case in the file's 21 has a refused string a correct answer would naturally quote back. Drop the assertion, or refuse something only a wrong answer writes (for example a deleted and re-added position with no `renamedFrom`); `must_contain` already pins both halves of the right answer.

**N-1 (nit)** — the boot log also lists activation-ledger rows (module doc, line 82); the parenthesis omits them. Harmless at this length.

**N-2 (nit)** — "(the environment: a set authored in Setup; a second package shipping a name is refused at install)" compresses two glosses into a parenthesis that needs the old text to parse. Leave unless bytes come free.

Card items 1, 2 and 4 are met and hold against main. Item 3 is written, and wrong in the one clause M-1 names.

Reviewed-by: `session_01ADHkmRxXmVQ41fqnaTPGAv`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b9479f0dbcab87c514e205e47a5646c654df990c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md, skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, .changeset/33566-skills-position-rename-own-source.md

Delta review, fix round 1, over the record in comment 6899620269 (FAIL on `169a40a0`). Read-only shape: the diff of fix commit `653fe698` over `169a40a0`, the merge commit `b9479f0d`, the whole PR diff against main, the cited code on main, and the head's check-runs. Everything the first record judged as holding is unchanged by this round and stands.

### ① Derived judgments

- The merge authored nothing. `b9479f0d` has parents `653fe698` and main `27c2f1ea`; its tree `696f9a92` is byte-identical to the automatic merge of those two parents, and its diff against `27c2f1ea` is exactly the PR's four files. Main has since moved to `f81e4b6c` with no change under `skills/` or to the ratchet script; the head still merges clean.
- M-1, closed. The paragraph now reads "Only holders: no other reference to the old name is rewritten, Setup-authored ones included." That is what the code says and no more: `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-renamed-holder-carry.ts` module doc, "Holders only (ruling A1). Every other stored reference to an old name stays as it is" and "Not a metadata rewrite". It no longer denies the read of a Setup-authored position's own `renamedFrom`, which `position-renamed-holder-carry.test.ts:347-361` shows carried. The same correction is in eval 21's `expected_output` ("Only holders move: no other reference to the old name is rewritten") and in the changeset prose ("rewrites no other reference to the old name, Setup-authored ones included"). No copy of the old sentence remains in the diff.
- S-1, closed. "`tabPermissions` hides an app, never gates it: objectstack-ui → Who sees or opens an app." is back in its old place. The target exists: `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md:48` `## Who sees or opens an app`. The sentence is true against that home: the key "takes the app off its holders' Home tiles, App Switcher and `app:launcher` block ... its URL still opens. Not an access gate." Naming the heading is a better pointer than the old "Navigation".
- S-2, closed. Eval 21's `must_not_contain` is an empty array; `must_contain` is unchanged and both strings occur in `expected_output`. An empty array is within the file's convention (case 13 carries one), and no gate under `scripts/` reads the assertion keys. A before-and-after answer now passes.
- Rest of the paragraph: re-wrapped only; the re-point list, the boot-log sentence and the not-carried list are word for word as reviewed.
- Ratchet. The diff to `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is one row and its comment: `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` 3959 to 3986. The head file measures 15942 bytes and ceil(15942 / 4) is 3986, so the row is pinned at the measurement with zero headroom, as the neighbouring rows are. The comment states the facts added, quotes the standing ruling (record 6513306068), names what was paid down first and each cut's home, and cites card #33566. The raise follows the ruling: seven in-place cuts were made first and survive this round, and only the measured remainder (net +108 bytes on main's 15834) moves the row. The comment's gross figure of 313 bytes paid down was not recomputed here; the net is measured.

Check-runs on the head, read at 19:30Z: no failure. The full run on this head is complete and green: Build Core, Test Core (three shards and the roll-up), every Lint and Type Check job, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate. A second Check Changeset and PR-body guards run, started at 19:29Z by the body edit, was still in progress at the read; the record does not vouch for that re-run.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: patch on the skills package; `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the changeset. The changeset prose now says the ceiling moves by the measured remainder, which is true of the diff. A moved ratchet row is tooling, not a published surface, and does not change the level.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The dev's open question is settled as answered: the pointer is restored, shorter.
- File surface: the ratchet script is new to the diff. The order allows it ("ratchet rows only if they move") and says a moved row makes the PR Tier H; the thread reports Tier H. Not re-run here.
- SQL push-down: no code path in the diff.
- Security: no security item found.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix and no should-fix is open.

**N-1 (nit, accepted as left)** — the boot-log parenthesis omits activation-ledger rows. Harmless; adding it would cost bytes on a row already raised.

**N-2 (nit, accepted as left)** — the parenthesis after "as for a queue above" is terse. It is correct, and the definitions it leans on are in the bullet it names.

All four card items are met and hold against main.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-4na0we`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ADHkmRxXmVQ41fqnaTPGAv`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-data` 的 `rules/security.md`「Renaming a position」一段补齐四点:作者要自己改包源码里写着旧岗位名的地方(共享接收方、队列成员与审批人、策略 `positions`、`current_user.positions`);重命名的拒绝条件改为「另一个所有者(包或环境)」;明说启动时只搬岗位持有人,不改写任何其他引用,包括 Setup 写的;恢复 explain 接口的门(`manage_users`、管理其所在组织、或覆盖其的委派 `adminScope`)。eval 加第 21 例。为腾篇幅删了同文件八处重复,各有存活处;余额按实测把 token 棚 3959→3986。changeset `@objectstack/skills: patch`。
- 为什么改:PR #33480 的达档复审(6886676047)指出这段让作者以为看完启动日志就没事了,且漏了环境这个所有者;explain 的权限规则被那次删掉了。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文字、一个评测用例和一行棚值,不动运行时。回滚 = revert。
- 先看:`security.md`「Renaming a position」那段,和恢复的 `tabPermissions` 一行。
- 两分钟验证:对照 `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-renamed-holder-carry.ts` 模块注释与 `security-plugin-explain-access.ts#mayDescribeAnotherUser`,看句子是否逐条对得上。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(diff 含 `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,且路径名含 security,低风险技能臂不适用)。达档(CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER)复审:首轮 6899620269 FAIL(M-1 一句措辞不实),delta 6900037119 在本 head PASS,全部关闭。请批准并合并,或批准后由席位落地。
- 席位意见:可以合。

## 席位核对

**Verdict: ACCEPT, held for the maintainer** · head `b9479f0dbcab87c514e205e47a5646c654df990c` · card #33566 · report 6899557790 · at-tier contract review 6899620269 (FAIL on `169a40a0`: M-1, S-1, S-2, N-1, N-2) → delta 6900037119 (PASS on this head, M-1/S-1/S-2 closed) · read 2026-11-15T19:31Z.

- **Shape:** draft → `main`, `Fixes #33566`. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`, eval case 21 in the data skill's evals, one ratchet row (`security.md` 3959 → 3986, pinned to the measured 15942 bytes), changeset `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. **GOVERNED**, Tier H (`check-governed-merges --pr 34105` exit 3). `Clause-②: no`; `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Premise measured:** PR #33480 merged as `8e63ed87`; none of the four items was on main. Each added sentence was checked against main: the holder carry's module doc and tests, the `owned-by-other` refusal and `OVERLAY_PROVENANCE_SENTINEL`, and the explain gate `mayDescribeAnotherUser`.
- **Gates:** on this head the full CI run is complete and green, none failed; dev on this head: 63 derived, 63 exit 0, `--ran` reconciles; skill-docs, skill-refs, skill-examples green.
- **Accepted deviations:** authoring by a subagent pinned to `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` inside a lower-tier thread (declared in the claim and body). Main merged in, nothing authored in the merge. The ratchet raise follows the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」: eight same-file cuts first, the measured remainder moves the row. The dev's open question (keep the `tabPermissions` cut) was ruled B by the seat: restored in a short form (review S-1). Nits N-1 (the boot-log parenthesis omits activation-ledger rows) and N-2 (one parenthesis reads hard) are left as they are.
- **Out of scope:** none filed.
- **Landing:** Tier H. The seat does not flip this PR ready or enqueue it. It needs the maintainer's merge, or an authorised APPROVED review after which the seat lands it.

Serial note for the maintainer: this PR and PR #34019 (card #33978) both edit `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` and the same row of `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (#34019: 3959 → 4041; this PR: 3959 → 3986), each measured against main alone. Whichever merges second will conflict on that row, and its ceiling must be re-measured on the combined file. Merge either one; the seat then merges main into the other, re-pins the row to the measured size (paying in place first), and runs a delta review before it asks again. Neither PR needs anything from you beyond the merge.
